content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.
I'll create an animated SVG with an anteater on a unicycle juggling bottles. Let me build this step by step.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">
  <defs>
    <!-- Sky gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#a8e6ff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e8f9ff"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Ground gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="groundGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8fd694"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5fae64"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Anteater body gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="furGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8b6d4f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5e4631"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Snout gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="snoutGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6b5138"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a07b52"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Bottle glass gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="glassGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4caf7d"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#8ee0b0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2e8b57"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Shadow filter -->
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="2" dy="4" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.25"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Wheel spin animation -->
    <g id="wheel">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="62" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="8"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="54" fill="none" stroke="#f2f2f2" stroke-width="3"/>
      <!-- spokes -->
      <g stroke="#d0d0d0" stroke-width="2.5">
        <line x1="0" y1="-54" x2="0" y2="54"/>
        <line x1="-54" y1="0" x2="54" y2="0"/>
        <line x1="-38" y1="-38" x2="38" y2="38"/>
        <line x1="-38" y1="38" x2="38" y2="-38"/>
        <line x1="-20" y1="-50" x2="20" y2="50"/>
        <line x1="-50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="-20"/>
        <line x1="-50" y1="-20" x2="50" y2="20"/>
        <line x1="-20" y1="50" x2="20" y2="-50"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="7" fill="#333"/>
      <!-- valve marker to make spin visible -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="-46" r="5" fill="#e74c3c"/>
    </g>

    <!-- A bottle definition, origin at its center -->
    <g id="bottle">
      <rect x="-13" y="8" width="26" height="36" rx="7" fill="url(#glassGrad)" stroke="#1d6b45" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="-7" y="-6" width="14" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#glassGrad)" stroke="#1d6b45" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="-9" y="-12" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#d94f3d" stroke="#9c2f22" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="-9" y="18" width="18" height="16" rx="2" fill="#f5f0d8" stroke="#c9c09a" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <path d="M -7 0 Q 0 -3 7 0" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="-9" y="24" width="18" height="3" fill="#4a7c59" opacity="0.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Anteater full figure, drawn around seat point (0,0) at saddle -->
    <g id="anteater">
      <!-- tail (big bushy) -->
      <path d="M -18 8 C -80 -6 -130 30 -150 86 C -126 66 -96 62 -74 70 C -98 84 -110 104 -112 128 C -84 100 -52 88 -20 88 Z"
            fill="url(#furGrad)" stroke="#3f2f20" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#softShadow)">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-6 -18 8; 8 -18 8; -6 -18 8" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
      <!-- tail stripes -->
      <path d="M -60 30 Q -80 45 -92 68 M -84 46 Q -104 66 -112 92" fill="none" stroke="#3f2f20" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.6"/>

      <!-- torso -->
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="-38" rx="42" ry="52" fill="url(#furGrad)" stroke="#3f2f20" stroke-width="2.5" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
      <!-- chest stripe -->
      <path d="M 14 -78 Q 34 -40 14 -2" fill="none" stroke="#2f2318" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>

      <!-- back leg to pedal -->
      <g>
        <path d="M -12 2 Q -34 40 -22 74" fill="none" stroke="#5e4631" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M -12 2 Q -34 40 -22 74" fill="none" stroke="#3f2f20" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <ellipse cx="-22" cy="76" rx="14" ry="8" fill="#3f2f20" transform="rotate(-20 -22 76)"/>
      </g>

      <!-- front leg to pedal -->
      <g>
        <path d="M 16 2 Q 34 42 22 76" fill="none" stroke="#6b5138" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M 16 2 Q 34 42 22 76" fill="none" stroke="#3f2f20" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <ellipse cx="22" cy="76" rx="14" ry="8" fill="#3f2f20" transform="rotate(20 22 76)"/>
      </g>

      <!-- neck/head -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-4 0 -78; 4 0 -78; -4 0 -78" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <ellipse cx="6" cy="-100" rx="30" ry="27" fill="url(#furGrad)" stroke="#3f2f20" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <!-- long snout -->
        <path d="M 24 -104 C 60 -108 96 -98 122 -84 C 96 -74 60 -70 26 -78 Z"
              fill="url(#snoutGrad)" stroke="#3f2f20" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
        <!-- nose tip -->
        <ellipse cx="120" cy="-85" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#2b2018"/>
        <!-- eye -->
        <circle cx="14" cy="-108" r="6.5" fill="#fff"/>
        <circle cx="16" cy="-108" r="3.6" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
        <circle cx="17.2" cy="-109.4" r="1.2" fill="#fff"/>
        <!-- ear -->
        <ellipse cx="-8" cy="-118" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#5e4631" stroke="#3f2f20" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(-25 -8 -118)"/>
        <!-- tongue (flicking) -->
        <path d="M 108 -80 Q 130 -70 138 -82" fill="none" stroke="#e07a8a" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animate attributeName="d" values="M 108 -80 Q 130 -70 138 -82; M 108 -80 Q 134 -58 142 -66; M 108 -80 Q 130 -70 138 -82" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </path>
      </g>

      <!-- arms juggling -->
      <g id="leftArm">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-18 6 -62; 8 6 -62; -18 6 -62" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <path d="M 6 -62 Q -14 -44 -24 -30" fill="none" stroke="#6b5138" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="-25" cy="-29" r="8" fill="#3f2f20"/>
        <!-- claws -->
        <path d="M -30 -32 l -8 -6 M -28 -26 l -9 -2 M -24 -23 l -7 4" stroke="#e8dcc0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
      <g id="rightArm">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-8 30 -60; 20 30 -60; -8 30 -60" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <path d="M 30 -60 Q 50 -44 58 -30" fill="none" stroke="#6b5138" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="59" cy="-29" r="8" fill="#3f2f20"/>
        <path d="M 64 -32 l 8 -6 M 62 -26 l 9 -2 M 58 -23 l 7 4" stroke="#e8dcc0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- BACKGROUND -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>
  <!-- clouds -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 40 0; 0 0" dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <ellipse cx="130" cy="90" rx="46" ry="20"/><ellipse cx="170" cy="80" rx="34" ry="24"/><ellipse cx="95" cy="82" rx="28" ry="18"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; -35 0; 0 0" dur="22s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <ellipse cx="660" cy="130" rx="40" ry="18"/><ellipse cx="700" cy="122" rx="30" ry="22"/><ellipse cx="625" cy="124" rx="26" ry="16"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <!-- sun -->
  <circle cx="690" cy="80" r="34" fill="#ffe680">
    <animate attributeName="r" values="34;38;34" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <!-- hills -->
  <path d="M 0 430 Q 200 370 400 430 Q 600 370 800 430 L 800 600 L 0 600 Z" fill="#9ad99f" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="500" width="800" height="100" fill="url(#groundGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="556" rx="120" ry="14" fill="#3f7d45" opacity="0.45">
    <animate attributeName="rx" values="120;132;120" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </ellipse>

  <!-- ===== UNICYCLE + ANTEATER (bobbing as a unit) ===== -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -6; 0 0; 0 5; 0 0" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- wheel -->
    <g transform="translate(400 490)">
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <use href="#wheel"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- fork/frame -->
    <path d="M 400 490 L 400 424" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 388 424 L 412 424" stroke="#922b21" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- seat post -->
    <rect x="394" y="404" width="12" height="22" rx="3" fill="#7f8c8d"/>
    <!-- saddle -->
    <path d="M 372 404 Q 400 392 428 404 Q 400 414 372 404 Z" fill="#2c3e50" stroke="#1a252f" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- pedals rotating opposite-ish -->
    <g transform="translate(400 490)">
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <line x1="-26" y1="0" x2="26" y2="0" stroke="#555" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <rect x="-34" y="-4" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#333"/>
        <rect x="16" y="-4" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#333"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- anteater seated at saddle -->
    <g transform="translate(400 400)">
      <use href="#anteater"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== JUGGLED BOTTLES (cascade pattern above the anteater) ===== -->
  <g>
    <!-- Bottle 1: left hand up, arcs right -->
    <g>
      <animateMotion dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        path="M 375 371 C 330 250 370 170 400 150 C 445 170 470 260 425 371 C 420 385 385 385 375 371 Z"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" additive="sum" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <use href="#bottle"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Bottle 2: right hand up, arcs left (half-cycle offset) -->
    <g>
      <animateMotion dur="1.8s" begin="-0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        path="M 375 371 C 330 250 370 170 400 150 C 445 170 470 260 425 371 C 420 385 385 385 375 371 Z"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" additive="sum" type="rotate" from="0" to="-360" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <use href="#bottle"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Bottle 3: center high, offset again -->
    <g>
      <animateMotion dur="1.8s" begin="-1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        path="M 375 371 C 330 250 370 170 400 150 C 445 170 470 260 425 371 C 420 385 385 385 375 371 Z"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" additive="sum" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="0.75s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <use href="#bottle"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- motion sparkles near hands -->
  <g fill="#fff59d" opacity="0.9">
    <circle cx="372" cy="365" r="3">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;1" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="430" cy="365" r="3">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- caption -->
  <text x="400" y="580" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Comic Sans MS, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#2f5d34" font-weight="bold">
    The Juggling Anteater
    <animate attributeName="fill" values="#2f5d34;#1a3d20;#2f5d34" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </text>
</svg>

content.text:
Created `anteater-unicycle.svg` — an animated scene featuring:

- 🐜 **Anteater** with a bushy swishing tail, flicking tongue, bobbing head, and juggling arms
- 🎡 **Unicycle** with a spinning spoked wheel, rotating pedals, and a saddle
- 🍾 **Three green bottles** following a staggered juggling cascade path with independent spins
- ☁️ Drifting clouds, a pulsing sun, rolling hills, and a subtly widening ground shadow
- A gently pulsing "The Juggling Anteater" caption

Open the file in any browser to see the animation. All motion uses native SMIL (`<animate>` / `<animateMotion>` / `<animateTransform>`), so no JavaScript is needed.
